create.name: Ann James
create.bio:
Ann James is an energy worker and sound practitioner in Woodville, in the Big Thicket country of south-east Texas, where she runs Mystical Energies from a studio beside her rock shop. Her interest in inner practice began with Transcendental Meditation and yoga in the 1970s; years later, while working as a hospital dietitian, she was introduced to Reiki and went on to become a Reiki Master/Teacher in 1997. She certified as a Quantum-Touch practitioner in 2007 and as an instructor a year later, and has also trained in Healing Touch, Theta Healing, Access Bars and Vibrational Sound Therapy.

Her individual sessions blend Reiki, Quantum-Touch, Healing Touch and colour work, sometimes with singing bowls, crystal pyramids or tuning forks, and can be held in person or at a distance. She teaches Reiki at every level up to Master/Teacher and runs one-day Access Bars classes. Much of her community work is sound: she plays Tibetan and quartz crystal bowls and gongs at regular sound baths and gong baths in her studio and at venues around Beaumont, and hosts private group sessions on request.

courses.title: Energy healing sessions
courses.description: Half-hour or hour sessions that combine Reiki, Quantum-Touch, Healing Touch and colour work, with singing bowls or tuning forks when it feels right. Sessions are held in her Woodville studio or at a distance, with an intake form beforehand.

courses.title: Reiki attunements and training
courses.description: Reiki classes at Level 1, Level 2, Master and Master/Teacher. Each class covers the teaching for that level, the attunement, course materials and hands-on practice.
courses.price: Level 1: $175; Level 2: $250; Reiki Master: $450 (one day); Reiki Master/Teacher: $650 (two days)

courses.title: Sound for the Soul sound baths
courses.description: Group sound baths with Tibetan or quartz crystal singing bowls, held monthly at a venue in Beaumont and at other venues, plus private group sessions in her shop or at your own space. Bring a mat, blanket and pillow.
